question: Of the two groups, how many silos were in the group with the lower pH, and what acetic acid concentration did that group have?
question_long: Of the two alfalfa silage groups, how many silos were in the group with the lower pH, and what acetic acid concentration did that group have?
rendered:
According to the document, 49 silos were in the group with the lower pH (LPGood group). 

The LPGood group had a significantly (p < 0.05) lower pH value, and the acetic acid concentration in the LPGood group was 11.27 ± 0.16 g/kg DM.
